main.description: Accounts whose handle matches what is typed, best first, for a field where a handle is typed. Where the host looks is its ACTOR_SEARCH: a typeahead service that knows the whole network, or, on a network of its own, the handles its PLC directory names. Anyone may ask. Under two letters, or when the host cannot look, none.

q.description: What has been typed of a handle, a leading @ let go.

actor.description: An account that matched: its DID and handle, and its name and picture where the service knows them; a directory knows neither.

displayName.description: Its name, as its profile gives it.
